challenges.title: Handle Hunter
challenges.author: Nour Gharbi
challenges.description:
A club member uses the same handle everywhere. One of their profiles has a bio that was never meant to be public.

All evidence is a set of offline HTML snapshots attached below — no real accounts, no live lookups, nothing to report.

**Goal:** find the profile that leaks the flag.

hints.text: Search the handle, not the person.
Check the profile the member made for a throwaway project — the bio field is the giveaway.

challenges.title: Where in Tunis?
challenges.author: Omar Ben Amor
challenges.description:
A photo posted by a partner club, with the location stripped. You get the image description, the visible shopfronts and the shadows.

Everything needed is in the attached evidence sheet.

**Goal:** identify the café. The flag is `SNT{<cafe-name-lowercase-hyphenated>}`.

hints.text: One of the shopfronts is a chain with only three branches in the city.
Compare the shadow direction with the stated capture time to work out which side of the street it faces.

challenges.title: Archive Dive
challenges.author: Nour Gharbi
challenges.description:
A partner organisation removed a page after a security incident. The page is gone from the live site; the archive is less forgetful.

The attachment contains three archived snapshots of the domain from 2024, 2025 and 2026.

**Goal:** find the removed page and the flag that was left in its HTML comment.

hints.text: Diff the 2025 and 2026 sitemaps. Something disappeared.
The removed page is still referenced by an old RSS feed.

challenges.title: The Alias Graph
challenges.author: Nour Gharbi
challenges.description:
Three personas, one human. A forum account, a freelance profile and a GitHub organisation, all carefully separated — except for the details people forget: a timezone, a reused avatar hash, a package name.

All data is synthetic and bundled offline.

**Goal:** connect the three personas and recover the flag hidden in the earliest commit message of the shared repository.

hints.text: Start from image reuse: compare avatar hashes across platforms.
The forum signature mentions a city; the freelance profile lists a working hour overlap; the repo has one contributor in that timezone.
